content.title: Eric Dane’s final acting role teased in ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 trailer after his tragic death
content.text: Eric Dane’s final acting role before his death was teased in the new “Euphoria” Season 3 trailer.The teaser released Monday shows Dane’s character, Cal Jacobs, reuniting with Jules (Hunter Schafer) Jules, whom he hooked up with in Season 1.“Remember me?” Jules asks Cal, who is dressed in a suit.“How can I forget?” Cal replies.Eric Dane appears in the trailer for “Euphoria” Season 3, which he filmed before his death in February 2026. HBO MaxThe trailer shows Dane’s character, Cal Jacobs, reuniting with Jules, played by Hunter Schafer. HBO MaxDane returned to his role as Nate Jacobs’ (Jacob Elordi) father in the hit HBO series before he died on February 19 at age 53.He filmed scenes for Season 3 while he was battling Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).Last June, Dane told Access Hollywood that it was “great to be back” on set after a four-year break between seasons.“I can assure you that we are in production and we are shooting a really great TV show,” he added.Dane (seen above with co-star Jacob Elordi) filmed “Euphoria” Season 3 while he was battling ALS. HBOHe told Access Hollywood in June 2025 that it was “great to be back” on set. Eddy Chen/HBODuring his final interview before his death on Netflix’s “Famous Last Words,” Dane shared that he “put a lot of effort” into his “Euphoria” role.“Cal and I are very similar in that we know what it’s like to lead a double life,” the “Grey’s Anatomy” alum explained. “I’ve had experience with that with my battle with drugs and alcohol. I know what it is like to not have my insides match my outside.”After Dane’s passing, several “Euphoria” actors paid tribute to their late co-star on social media,In his final interview before his death, Dane said he “put a lot of effort” into his role on the show. Instagram/Janell ShirtcliffDane (seen above in a wheelchair at LAX in November 2025) starred in “Euphoria” with Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, and more. BACKGRIDSydney Sweeney, who plays Cassie Howard, reshared a clip from his heartbreaking final video message to his daughters, Billie and Georgia, and wrote, “Forever will love you.”Barbie Ferreira, who played Kat Hernandez before exiting the series after Season 2, similarly took to Instagram Stories to re-share Dane’s “Famous Last Words” clip.Meanwhile, show creator Sam Levinson said he was “heartbroken” over the loss “of our dear friend” in a statement to Page Six.“Working with him was an honor. Being his friend was a gift,” Levinson continued. “Eric’s family is in our prayers. May his memory be for a blessing.”After his death, creator “Sam Levinson” told Page Six he was “heartbroken” over the loss “of our dear friend” (Dane is pictured above in “Euphoria” Season 1). Eddy Chen/HBODane is survived by his estranged wife, Rebecca Gayheart, and their two daughters, Billie and Georgia. NetflixThe new season of “Euphoria” will star Dane, Schafer, Elordi, Sweeney, Zendaya, Alexa Demie, Maude Apatow, Colman Domingo, Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry and Nika King.New cast members include Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Toby Wallace, Sharon Stone and Marshawn Lynch.“Euphoria” Season 3 premieres Sunday, April 12, at 9 pm ET on HBO and HBO Max.
